title: An Incremental Knowledge-Graph Learner Digital Twin for Evidence-Grounded Early Warning
abstract: arXiv:2610.36820v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Early-warning models in learning analytics can identify learners at risk of failure or withdrawal, but the resulting alerts are often only weakly connected to inspectable learning evidence. A risk score may indicate that intervention is needed without showing which traces, assessment events, or temporal patterns justify the alert. This paper introduces an incremental Learner Digital Twin for evidence-grounded early warning, implemented as a lightweight knowledge graph. The twin is updated at temporal checkpoints by replaying learning traces and assessment records, and it serves both as a feature-extraction substrate and as an explanation-grounding substrate. Predictive features are derived through graph-mediated queries, while features, attributions, alerts, evidence items, and raw records are represented as queryable graph entities. translated_title: 面向证据支撑早期预警的增量式知识图谱学习者数字孪生
translated_abstract: 学习分析领域的早期预警模型能够识别面临学业失败或退学风险的学习者，但由此产生的预警往往与可查验的学习证据关联薄弱。风险分数可能仅表明需要干预，却不展示究竟是哪些学习轨迹、测评事件或时间模式支撑了该预警。本文提出了一种面向证据支撑早期预警的增量式学习者数字孪生，并以轻量级知识图谱的形式加以实现。该数字孪生通过回放学习轨迹与测评记录，在时间检查点上不断更新，既可作为特征提取的基础，也可作为解释溯源的基础。预测特征通过基于图谱的查询推导得出，而特征、归因、预警、证据条目及原始记录均以可查询的图实体形式表示。该框架在一个公开的学习分析基准数据集上进行了实例化与评估，并在时间（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种基于轻量级知识图谱的增量式学习者数字孪生，将特征、归因、预警与原始学习记录统一表示为可查询的图实体，从而实现有证据支撑、可解释的学业风险早期预警。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an incremental learner digital twin built on a lightweight knowledge graph, which represents features, attributions, alerts, and raw learning records as queryable graph entities to enable evidence-grounded and explainable early warning of academic risk.
